locations.name: Survival job selection
locations.area: Pause Menu → Online → Jobs → Play Job → Rockstar Created → Survivals
locations.note:
Select the Halloween Survival named in the current offer. Ludendorff Cemetery is entered through a job or its Survival map blip; do not try to drive to North Yankton in Freemode. Availability follows the current playlist.

This week: Halloween Survivals — 3X GTA$ & RP; Ludendorff Cemetery Survival, Cayo Perico Survival and Alien Survivals.

locations.name: Freemode ghost photography
locations.area: Southern San Andreas → follow the Ghosts Exposed text and current event clues
locations.note:
Use your phone’s Snapmatic camera to photograph the ghosts and check progress in the Interaction Menu. This is a Freemode search, not a mission started at a property. This guide has not verified this year’s individual ghost coordinates or spawn hours.

This week: Ghosts Exposed — 2X GTA$; photograph the ghosts.

locations.name: Vincent’s Dispatch Work
locations.area: Freemode → your owned Law Enforcement personal vehicle
locations.note:
First complete Slush Fund from The Cluckin’ Bell Farm Raid as leader. While driving your Law Enforcement vehicle, request Dispatch Work with the displayed prompt (R3/RS on console, B on PC). Follow Vincent’s assigned mission markers; there is no single fixed destination.

This week: Dispatch Work — 2X GTA$ & RP

locations.name: Your Bail Office
locations.area: Your owned Bail Office → bounty selection
locations.note:
Start the bounty from your Bail Office and follow the assigned target markers. Standard and Most Wanted targets have different availability; check the current target selection and the exact weekly challenge below. Dispatch Work is a separate activity and does not substitute for securing a Bail Office bounty.

This week: Bail Office Bounties — Secure two Bail Office Bounties to receive the Green Vintage Skull Mask and GTA$100,000.

locations.name: Community Series matchmaking
locations.area: Legion Square → series marker, or phone → Quick Join
locations.note:
Use the Community Series marker or your phone’s Quick Join selection. Select the current Community Race Series when the offer names races; other community-created jobs do not automatically qualify for that bonus.

This week: Community Race Series — 3X GTA$ & RP

locations.name: Los Santos Car Meet
locations.area: Cypress Flats → LS Car Meet map icon
locations.note:
Enter the Car Meet and check Prize Ride Challenge in the Interaction Menu. Join the required LS Car Meet race series and check your progress after each result. Consecutive-day requirements need separate qualifying days; collect the reward from the Prize Ride menu after completion.

This week: Vapid Dominator GTT — place top 5 in a LS Car Meet Race for 3 days in a row to unlock the Vapid Dominator GTT

locations.name: Mobile weapons dealer
locations.area: Daily rotating stop in Southern San Andreas
locations.note:
The stock below belongs to this week; the parking spot changes daily. Today’s exact stop is not verified in this guide. Without GTA+, the van icon appears when you are nearby; GTA+ members can locate it on the map. Approach the open rear doors to browse weapons and compare the price shown for your membership.

See This Week → Gun Van for the current stock and discounts.

locations.name: Freemode event cargo
locations.note:
Wait for a Business Battle in Freemode, then use the event’s cargo marker and delivery destination. Pick up and deliver the crates; the route is assigned by the event, not one permanent address. Check the current reward description below.

This week: UFO Business Battles — 2X GTA$ & RP
